scoring_justification: Transition pressure recomputed from enthalpy_data crossing; phonon stability recomputed from phonon_band_data frequencies; discharge voltage recomputed from raw_energies; band gaps and diffusion paths compared to paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for phase transition pressure, phonon stability, band gaps, discharge voltage, and Li diffusion barriers and coefficients.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's claimed computed results, verified against the reference solve.sh output.

required.enthalpy_data: array of objects with keys P (float, GPa), H_P21c (float, eV/f.u.), H_P42m (float, eV/f.u.)
required.transition_pressure_GPa: float, phase transition pressure where enthalpy curves cross
required.phonon_band_data: array of objects with keys q (array of floats) and frequency_cm1 (array of floats)
required.phonon_stable: bool, true if no imaginary frequencies within [-10,0] cm⁻¹
required.pbe_bandgap_eV: float, fundamental band gap from GGA-PBE calculation
required.hse06_bandgap_eV: float, band gap from HSE06 hybrid functional calculation
required.voltage_V: float, discharge voltage for the reaction 2Li⁺ + 2e⁻ + Li₂S₂ → 2Li₂S
required.diffusion_paths: array of objects with keys path_id (string), barrier_eV (float), hopping_distance_A (float), D_cm2_per_s (float)
required.raw_energies: object with keys E_Li2S2_eV (float), E_Li_eV (float), E_Li2S_eV (float)
required.P21c_structure: object containing keys: a (float), b (float), c (float), beta (float), sites (array of objects with atom (string), wyckoff (string), x (float), y (float), z (float))

outputs.description: Master result file containing the raw inputs and derived quantities for the paper’s main claims on phase transition, dynamical stability, band gaps, discharge voltage, and lithium diffusion. Also includes the discovered P2₁/c structure details.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute certain quantities (phase transition, phonon stability) from the raw data in this file and compare the reported values to hidden reference values from the literature. The newly added P21c_structure key is required to verify that the structure prediction step was correctly executed.

steps.description: Recompute crossing from enthalpy_data and check that the crossing pressure is within 0.5 GPa of the paper's 2.78 GPa.
Check that all phonon frequencies are above -1 cm⁻¹ and phonon_stable is true.
PBE band gap within ±0.2 eV of 1.74 eV.
HSE06 band gap within ±0.4 eV of 2.82 eV.
Recompute voltage from raw_energies and check against paper's 2.34 V.
Check each path's barrier and diffusion coefficient against paper values; also verify D = d²ν₀exp(-Ea/kBT).
